_README: EM tilt wrapper T1. Same discipline as data/ws6b_params.json: every figure carries its source, and 'uncertain': true means the pull could NOT confirm it from a published source and it is a stated assumption, NOT a verified figure - such a figure must be reported as uncertain wherever it propagates. Retrieval date for all pulls: 2026-09-19. This file compares WRAPPERS for one exposure (MSCI Emerging Markets), not a fund against its own constituents: direct replication of EM is infeasible and is recorded as such under 'direct_route_rejected'.
exposure: MSCI Emerging Markets Index (Net), Bloomberg NDUEEGF
context: Personal. The deployed tilt instrument is EEM, overlay-only since Phase 29 (scripts/build_simple_page.py TILT_TICKER).

source_country_withholding_differential.note: THE ONE MATERIAL GAP. Both funds hold non-US stocks and both suffer withholding in each source country at whatever rate that country's treaty with the fund's domicile allows. Ireland's and the United States' treaty networks over the large MSCI EM weights - Taiwan 25.7%, China 20.3%, South Korea 17.6%, India 12.3% (justETF country weights for IE00B0M63177 as of 2026-07-30) - are NOT the same, and this pull did not establish either. The differential could run in either direction and is deliberately NOT netted into the headline. Closing it needs treaty texts or a specialist, not a product page.

us_estate_tax.note: EEM is us_situs true and an Irish UCITS is not. US estate tax applies to US-situs assets of non-resident aliens above a USD 60,000 exemption, and Singapore has no US estate tax treaty. This is a LARGE asymmetric benefit of the Irish route that is deliberately left unpriced here. The vault already carries a caution that estate-tax figures in the ETF Starter work were not primary-sourced; the same caution applies. Needs counsel.

switching_cost.note: One-off: sell EEM, buy the Irish line, crossing two spreads plus commission, plus any capital gains consequence (none for a SG individual on equities, not verified here) and time out of the market.

direct_route_rejected.note: Direct replication of EM constituents is rejected before any tax argument. From the holdings archive: ICHN needs 216 names to reach 90% of fund weight, IJPN 164, NDIA 75, ITWN 53. Norgate carries no non-US equity data, so the basket could be neither backtested nor tracked; the vault already established that Norgate sells no European product at any tier. Several of these markets also gate foreign investors behind registration. No further work proposed.
